reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown trace the 700-vs-7000 horsemen conflict between 2 Samuel 8:4 and 1 Chronicles 18:4 to a scribal confusion of two similar Hebrew numeral letters.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses the plain numbers, asking simply whether David took seven hundred or seven thousand horsemen.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
